questions: what causes this pinealblastoma genetic etiology

followOn.summary: PLAGL2 is a zinc-finger transcription factor. Loss of let-7/miR-98-5p causes PLAGL2 derepression because those miRNAs normally repress it. Therefore pineoblastoma programs can activate CCND2.
followOn.evidence: The DICER1/let-7 axis causes PLAGL2 upregulation because miRNA repression fails. Therefore CCND2 transcription rises.

followOn.summary: CCND2 encodes cyclin D2. PLAGL2 causes CCND2 transcription because the factor binds cyclin-D promoters. Therefore cell-cycle drive increases in pineoblastoma models.
followOn.evidence: CCND2 is caused to rise after PLAGL2 derepression because the let-7 target axis is intact. Therefore cases track the microprocessor genes.
